title: LamdaFunction cell envelope, format lamdafunction-cells-1
description: Hexahedral cells with corners, frames and explicit neighbours: what a shell builder, a box envelope or another host (TopologicPy, SpaceTope) hands the compiler. Written and read by addon/model/cells.py; meanings in its module docstring. The compiler also checks what a schema cannot: every port of every cell is exactly one neighbour or exposed, and every neighbour is listed from both sides with swapped ports and the same twist.

corners.description: Per cell, eight corners in unit-cube order x + 2y + 4z (x from the -X face to the +X face, and so on).

frames.description: Per cell, origin, x, y, z for rigid placement. Optional: derived from the corners when absent.

sources.description: Per cell, where it came from, e.g. ["face", 12, 0] (mesh face and layer) or ["cell", x, y, z]. Optional.

neighbours.description: [cell, port, other cell, other port, twist], both directions, sorted by (cell, port).

exposed.description: [cell, port, group] for every port without a neighbour, sorted by (cell, port). Groups such as top, bottom, rim pick the boundary policy.

weights.description: Module name or #tag to one multiplier per cell; at or below 0 removes the module.
